full_details: In the morning you looked at the forty leaves and did not copy them onto a clean sheet. Gib stayed on the Holinshed. You did not open the coffer. At the Theatre the bill in the house was Seven Days, a title and no sum, and you did not go over the water. You played Navarre. Kemp added nothing, and Garnish's tally stayed where it was, nineteen lines and a noise like a goose. Kemp and Phillips walked you down to Bishopsgate and stayed. The parish had its fire, birch over the doors, bread and ale at the better houses. The watch was doubled and went by in harness, and the constables had their eyes on every knot of boys. Nobody leapt. A boy supervised the grown men, and they did not know it. Phillips tapped the bells on the doorpost. Mistress Ansell stayed twenty minutes and took Alse in. Verbeke stayed at the door of the close. It was warm and still. At home you said it ought to have been the merriest night of the year.
one_sentence: You looked at the forty leaves, played Navarre to a thin yard, and stood at the parish fire in Bishopsgate.
title: Played Navarre and stood at the parish fire
